# Ulang-Tahun-Caming<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Ucapan Ulang Tahun Romantis</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@0.577.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Alegreya:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root { --ink:#fff8ed; --muted:#f5d7c4; --wine:#6e1e2e; --rose:#df6678; --gold:#f2bd7a; --paper:#fff6e7; }
    * { box-sizing:border-box; }
    body { margin:0; width:100%; min-height:100vh; color:var(--ink); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; overflow-x:hidden; background:#35101d; }
    .surprise-cover { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:20; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:1.5rem; background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,rgba(207,91,111,.42),transparent 34%),#35101d; transition:opacity 700ms ease,visibility 700ms ease; }
    .surprise-cover.is-dismissed { opacity:0; visibility:hidden; pointer-events:none; }
    .surprise-card { width:min(100%,31rem); padding:clamp(2rem,7vw,4rem) 2rem; text-align:center; border:1px solid rgba(255,238,215,.3); border-radius:2rem; background:rgba(255,246,231,.1); box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(20,1,8,.42); animation:surprise-pulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .surprise-gift { display:grid; place-items:center; width:5rem; height:5rem; margin:0 auto 1.3rem; border-radius:1.4rem; color:#571727; background:#f2bd7a; font-size:2.2rem; box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(77,7,24,.35); animation:gift-bounce 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .surprise-title { margin:0 0 .7rem; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-size:clamp(2.4rem,8vw,4.4rem); font-weight:700; line-height:.95; color:#fff8ed; }
    .surprise-copy { margin:0 auto 1.6rem; max-width:20rem; color:#f5d7c4; line-height:1.6; }
    .surprise-button { min-height:3.2rem; padding:.8rem 1.4rem; border:0; border-radius:999px; color:#571727; background:#f2bd7a; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(77,7,24,.36); transition:transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; }
    .surprise-button:hover { transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); }
    .surprise-button:focus-visible,.love-button:focus-visible,.music-button:focus-visible,.gallery-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffd89f; outline-offset:3px; }
    @keyframes surprise-pulse { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(1deg)} }
    @keyframes gift-bounce { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(5deg)} }
    .romance-shell { width:100%; min-height:100vh; position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:2rem 1.25rem 3rem; isolation:isolate; background:radial-gradient(circle at 88% 0%,rgba(237,151,112,.2),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 4% 100%,rgba(240,83,116,.18),transparent 30%),#571727; }
    .main-frame { width:100%; max-width:1060px; margin:0 auto; }
    .hero-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.95fr) minmax(0,1.05fr); gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,5.5rem); align-items:center; margin-top:clamp(2rem,6vw,5.5rem); }
    .image-frame { position:relative; padding:.7rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,238,215,.35); border-radius:180px 180px 28px 28px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(27,4,9,.36); animation:rise-in .9s ease both; }
    .image-frame::after { content:"♥"; position:absolute; right:-1rem; bottom:1.8rem; display:grid; place-items:center; width:3.4rem; height:3.4rem; border-radius:50%; color:#fff6e7; background:#bc455d; border:5px solid #571727; font-size:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(48,4,14,.38); }
    .hero-photo { width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/5; object-fit:cover; border-radius:170px 170px 21px 21px; display:block; filter:sepia(15%) saturate(87%); }
    .eyebrow { display:flex; gap:.6rem; align-items:center; color:#f5c996; font-size:.74rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; animation:rise-in .65s ease .1s both; }
    .eyebrow::before { content:""; width:2rem; height:1px; background:currentColor; }
    .hero-title { margin:1rem 0 1.1rem; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-weight:700; line-height:.96; letter-spacing:-.025em; animation:rise-in .72s ease .2s both; font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6rem); color:#fff8ed; }
    .intro { max-width:31rem; margin:0; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.75; animation:rise-in .75s ease .3s both; }
    .action-row { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.8rem; margin-top:2rem; animation:rise-in .8s ease .4s both; }
    .love-button,.music-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.55rem; min-height:3rem; padding:.75rem 1.05rem; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease,background 180ms ease; }
    .love-button:hover,.music-button:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); }
    .love-button { color:#571727; background:#f2bd7a; box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(77,7,24,.36); }
    .music-button { border-color:rgba(255,233,204,.34); background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); color:#fff8ed; }
    .button-label { font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600; }
    .is-hidden { display:none!important; }
    .memory-gallery { margin-top:clamp(3rem,8vw,6rem); animation:rise-in .9s ease .45s both; }
    .gallery-heading { margin:0 0 1.2rem; color:#f5c996; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem); text-align:center; }
    .gallery-stage { position:relative; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(255,238,215,.28); border-radius:1.4rem; background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(27,4,9,.3); }
    .memory-slide { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,.9fr); align-items:stretch; }
    .memory-photo { width:100%; height:clamp(16rem,42vw,25rem); object-fit:cover; display:block; }
    .memory-caption { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,3rem); }
    .memory-caption p { margin:0; color:#fff8ed; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-size:clamp(1.35rem,3vw,2rem); line-height:1.25; }
    .gallery-controls { display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:.75rem; margin-top:1rem; }
    .gallery-button { min-height:2.7rem; padding:.65rem 1rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,233,204,.34); border-radius:999px; color:#fff8ed; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms ease,background 180ms ease; font-size:24px; }
    .gallery-button:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.16); transform:translateY(-2px); }
    .gallery-count { color:#f5d7c4; align-self:center; font-size:.85rem; }
    .letter-wrap { display:grid; grid-template-rows:0fr; opacity:0; margin-top:0; transition:grid-template-rows 600ms ease,opacity 400ms ease,margin-top 500ms ease; }
    .letter-wrap.is-open { grid-template-rows:1fr; opacity:1; margin-top:clamp(2.5rem,7vw,5rem); }
    .letter-inner { overflow:hidden; }
    .letter-paper { position:relative; padding:clamp(1.7rem,5vw,3.6rem); border-radius:20px; color:#531d2a; background:#fff6e7; box-shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(21,1,6,.24); }
    .letter-paper::before { content:"♡"; position:absolute; top:1.3rem; right:1.7rem; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; color:rgba(154,55,75,.3); font-size:3.5rem; }
    .letter-heading { margin:0 0 1rem; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1; color:#531d2a; }
    .letter-copy { max-width:720px; margin:0 0 1rem; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-size:1.3rem; line-height:1.5; color:#531d2a; }
    .signature { margin:1.5rem 0 0; font-family:"Alegreya",serif; font-size:1.55rem; font-style:italic; font-weight:600; color:#531d2a; }
    .bottom-note { margin:3.5rem auto 0; max-width:38rem; text-align:center; color:rgba(255,232,209,.7); font-size:.86rem; line-height:1.6; }
    .floating-heart { position:absolute; color:rgba(255,208,180,.36); pointer-events:none; animation:drift 7s ease-in-out infinite; z-index:-1; }
    .heart-one { top:23%; left:7%; font-size:1.4rem; } .heart-two { top:68%; right:8%; font-size:1.9rem; animation-delay:-2.5s; } .heart-three { top:11%; right:22%; font-size:1rem; animation-delay:-4s; }
    @keyframes rise-in { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
    @keyframes drift { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:.3} 50%{transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(10deg);opacity:.75} }
    @media (max-width:760px) { .romance-shell{padding-top:1.4rem} .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:2.3rem} .image-frame{max-width:320px;margin:0 auto} .hero-copy{text-align:center} .eyebrow{justify-content:center} .intro{margin-inline:auto} .action-row{justify-content:center} .hero-title{font-size:3.5rem} }
    @media (max-width:650px) { .memory-slide{grid-template-columns:1fr} .memory-photo{height:15rem} }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <section id="surprise-cover" class="surprise-cover" aria-labelledby="surprise-title">
    <div class="surprise-card">
      <div class="surprise-gift" aria-hidden="true">🎁</div>
      <h1 id="surprise-title" class="surprise-title">Ada kejutan untukmu</h1>
      <p class="surprise-copy">Buka perlahan, karena ini dibuat khusus untukmu.</p>
      <button id="surprise-button" type="button" class="surprise-button">Buka Kejutan</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="romance-shell">
    <span class="floating-heart heart-one" aria-hidden="true">♥</span>
    <span class="floating-heart heart-two" aria-hidden="true">♥</span>
    <span class="floating-heart heart-three" aria-hidden="true">♥</span>

    <header class="main-frame" aria-label="Pembuka halaman">
      <p class="eyebrow">Untuk seseorang yang istimewa</p>
    </header>

    <main class="main-frame">
      <section class="hero-grid" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
        <div class="image-frame">
          <img loading="lazy" class="hero-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pasangan tersenyum bahagia sambil menunjukkan hasil karya mereka">
        </div>
        <div class="hero-copy">
          <h1 id="hero-title" class="hero-title">Selamat Ulang Tahun, Sayang</h1>
          <p class="intro">Semoga hari ini dipenuhi tawa, cinta, dan semua hal kecil yang membuatmu bahagia. Terima kasih sudah menjadi bagian terindah dalam hidupku.</p>
          <div class="action-row">
            <button id="letter-toggle" type="button" class="love-button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="love-letter">
              <i data-lucide="mail-heart" aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18"></i>
              <span class="button-label open-label">Buka surat cinta</span>
              <span class="button-label close-label is-hidden">Tutup surat</span>
            </button>
            <button id="music-toggle" type="button" class="music-button" aria-pressed="false">
              <i data-lucide="music-2" aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18"></i>
              <span class="button-label play-label">Putar melodi</span>
              <span class="button-label stop-label is-hidden">Hentikan melodi</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="memory-gallery" aria-labelledby="gallery-heading">
        <h2 id="gallery-heading" class="gallery-heading">Potongan kenangan kita</h2>
        <div class="gallery-stage">
          <article class="memory-slide" data-slide="0">
            <img loading="lazy" class="memory-photo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Pasangan bersantai bersama sambil bergaya">
            <div class="memory-caption"><p>Setiap momen bersamamu selalu terasa istimewa.</p></div>
          </article>
          <article class="memory-slide is-hidden" data-slide="1">
            <img loading="lazy" class="memory-photo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Pasangan tersenyum lebar bersama">
            <div class="memory-caption"><p>Senyummu adalah tempat favoritku untuk pulang.</p></div>
          </article>
          <article class="memory-slide is-hidden" data-slide="2">
            <img loading="lazy" class="memory-photo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Pasangan berjalan malam hari di tengah kota">
            <div class="memory-caption"><p>Semoga cerita kita terus bertambah indah.</p></div>
          </article>
          <article class="memory-slide is-hidden" data-slide="3">
            <img loading="lazy" class="memory-photo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Momen santai sambil menikmati minuman favorit">
            <div class="memory-caption"><p>Aku mencintaimu, hari ini dan setiap hari.</p></div>
          </article>
        </div>
        <div class="gallery-controls">
          <button id="gallery-prev" type="button" class="gallery-button" aria-label="Foto sebelumnya">‹</button>
          <span id="gallery-count" class="gallery-count" aria-live="polite">1 / 4</span>
          <button id="gallery-next" type="button" class="gallery-button" aria-label="Foto berikutnya">›</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="love-letter" class="letter-wrap" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="letter-inner">
          <article class="letter-paper">
            <h2 class="letter-heading">Untukmu, dengan seluruh cintaku</h2>
            <p class="letter-copy">Di hari spesialmu ini, aku ingin kamu tahu betapa berharganya dirimu. Kehadiranmu membuat hari-hariku lebih hangat dan penuh warna.</p>
            <p class="letter-copy">Terima kasih untuk setiap tawa, pelukan, dan kenangan yang kita bagi. Semoga tahun ini membawamu lebih dekat pada semua impianmu. Aku akan selalu berada di sisimu.</p>
            <p class="signature">Dengan cinta, orang yang selalu memilihmu</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <footer>
        <p class="bottom-note">Dibuat dengan cinta, khusus untuk hari istimewamu.</p>
      </footer>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();

      const cover = document.getElementById("surprise-cover");
      document.getElementById("surprise-button").addEventListener("click", () => {
        cover.classList.add("is-dismissed");
        window.setTimeout(() => cover.remove(), 750);
      });

      const letterToggle = document.getElementById("letter-toggle");
      const letter = document.getElementById("love-letter");
      const openLabel = document.querySelector(".open-label");
      const closeLabel = document.querySelector(".close-label");

      letterToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isOpen = letter.classList.toggle("is-open");
        letterToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
        openLabel.classList.toggle("is-hidden", isOpen);
        closeLabel.classList.toggle("is-hidden", !isOpen);
      });

      const musicToggle = document.getElementById("music-toggle");
      const playLabel = document.querySelector(".play-label");
      const stopLabel = document.querySelector(".stop-label");
      let audioContext = null;
      let melodyTimer = null;
      let isPlaying = false;
      const notes = [261.63, 329.63, 392, 329.63, 293.66, 349.23, 440, 392];

      function playTone(frequency, startTime, duration) {
        const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
        const gain = audioContext.createGain();
        oscillator.type = "sine";
        oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, startTime);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, startTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.08, startTime + .04);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, startTime + duration);
        oscillator.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(audioContext.destination);
        oscillator.start(startTime);
        oscillator.stop(startTime + duration + .04);
      }

      function playPhrase() {
        if (!isPlaying || !audioContext) return;
        const now = audioContext.currentTime + .05;
        notes.forEach((note, index) => playTone(note, now + index * .38, .42));
      }

      function startMusic() {
        if (!audioContext) audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        audioContext.resume();
        isPlaying = true;
        playPhrase();
        melodyTimer = window.setInterval(playPhrase, 3150);
        musicToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
        playLabel.classList.add("is-hidden");
        stopLabel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      }

      function stopMusic() {
        isPlaying = false;
        window.clearInterval(melodyTimer);
        melodyTimer = null;
        musicToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
        playLabel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
        stopLabel.classList.add("is-hidden");
      }

      musicToggle.addEventListener("click", () => isPlaying ? stopMusic() : startMusic());

      const slides = [...document.querySelectorAll(".memory-slide")];
      const galleryCount = document.getElementById("gallery-count");
      let currentSlide = 0;

      function showSlide(nextSlide) {
        currentSlide = (nextSlide + slides.length) % slides.length;
        slides.forEach((slide, index) => slide.classList.toggle("is-hidden", index !== currentSlide));
        galleryCount.textContent = `${currentSlide + 1} / ${slides.length}`;
      }

      document.getElementById("gallery-prev").addEventListener("click", () => showSlide(currentSlide - 1));
      document.getElementById("gallery-next").addEventListener("click", () => showSlide(currentSlide + 1));
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
